title: THE SWORD IN THE RETIREMENT HOME // RED MOUNTAIN B&B
narrative: In a peaceful whitewashed hacienda in the Dornish Marches, Ser Arthur Dayne pours fresh mint tea for two tourists from Oldtown. 'Yes, I am the Sword of the Morning,' he smiles, dusting off his five-star reviews on RedMountainStay.com. 'Ned Stark didn't kill me. We realized fighting over a baby was stressful, so Howland Reed forged seven death certificates and I opened a charming four-bedroom bed-and-breakfast. Complimentary lemon biscuits included.'
resolvesPlotHole: Arthur Dayne Didn't Die at the Tower of Joy
introducesPlotHole: The Red Mountain Sword Bed & Breakfast

options.text: Lend Dawn to the true Sword of the Morning candidate.
Kick Gerold 'Darkstar' Dayne out for refusing to pay the cleaning fee.
Tell Howland Reed his security deposit from 283 AC has cleared.
